name: mixmatter
description: MixMatter 2.2: v1 source-aware editorial print reconstruction with bold recomposition, tactile collage, source-adaptive color, and strict source-text control.

interface.shortDescription: AI art direction for existing imagery
interface.longDescription: MixMatter reconstructs a user-supplied image rather than merely decorating it. It is built on the original v1 visual baseline: bold disassembly and recomposition, aggressive crop and scale shifts, selective photography, visible halftone or duotone, flattened graphic fields, tactile torn-paper collage, source-adaptive color, and strict source-text protection. Unrelated images must not collapse into one recurring blue/coral/botanical decorative template.
defaultPrompt: Process this image with MixMatter. Reconstruct the composition rather than applying a filter or decorative frame.
Make this image bold, flat, printed, and source-specific with MixMatter. Preserve semantic identity, not the original camera layout.
Rebuild this image with selective photography, halftone, graphic fields, and tactile collage. Do not add new text or reuse a fixed decorative template.
